user.title: Connect to Teslatlas Hub
user.description: Enter a public Teslatlas Hub endpoint.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address advertised by Teslatlas Hub.
data_description.use_tls: Use the released public TLS transport.

pair.title: Pair with Teslatlas Hub
pair.description: Enter the transient pairing secret shown by your Hub. It is not stored.

discovery.title: Confirm discovered Teslatlas Hub
discovery.description: Confirm whether the discovered public endpoint uses TLS. Zeroconf TXT properties are ignored until the public contract is frozen.

reauth_confirm.title: Repair Teslatlas Hub authentication
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a fresh transient pairing secret from the same Hub.

reconfigure_confirm.title: Change Teslatlas Hub endpoint
reconfigure_confirm.description: The new endpoint must resolve to the same Hub identity.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Hub
error.protocol_not_ready: The released Teslatlas public protocol is not available yet

abort.cannot_connect: The discovered service has no usable endpoint
abort.wrong_hub: The endpoint resolved to a different Hub identity
